'''Zirchros''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5341 BBY]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around the year [[3641 BBY]], Zirchros possessed a secret cache of artifacts that his [[Zirchros's father|father]] had owned that had come from an extinct [[Unidentified civilization (Zirchros)|civilization]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], Zirchros was [[Death/Legends|dying]] in his [[Zirchros's medical facility|medical facility]], and telling tales of his knowledge of the early Republic's criminal elements.

==Biography==
Zirchros was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] living during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]]<ref name="Memoirs of a Crimelord" /> around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5341 BBY]],<ref name="Birthdate" /> and he had a [[Zirchros's father|father]] who had obtained a collection of cultural artifacts from a [[Unidentified civilization (Zirchros)|civilization]] that had been extinct for some time by Zirchros's later years. At some point, Zirchros learned the location of the artifacts, and he also had a large amount of knowledge of the early criminal underworld of the Galactic Republic. When Zirchros came into possession of the artifacts, he kept them a secret.<ref name="Memoirs of a Crimelord" /> Around the year [[3641 BBY]],<ref name="TORdate">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Memoirs of a Crimelord}} is a quest in ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'', which game takes place roughly ten to twelve years after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] according to ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} lead writer, [[Daniel Erickson]]. {{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=5365704|text=Question ! :)}} Since the Treaty of Coruscant was signed in [[3653 BBY]] according to ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', this places the events of the game at approximately 3643 BBY to 3641 BBY. This article uses the date of 3641 BBY as an approximate date, but the actual date could be different.</ref> Zirchros was [[Death/Legends|dying]] in his [[Zirchros's medical facility|medical facility]] at the age of 1,700 years. As he stayed there, Zirchros told individuals about the old Republic underworld.<ref name="Memoirs of a Crimelord" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
One individual who came to talk to Zirchros for some time was able to obtain information about the artifacts, obtain them, and bring them back to an individual they worked with.<ref name="Memoirs of a Crimelord" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Near the end of his life, Zirchros was willing to share stories of his knowledge of early Republic criminal elements. At the age of 1,700 years, he had lived a long time for a member of the Hutt species.<ref name="Memoirs of a Crimelord" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zirchros is first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]]. He is featured in the archaeology crew skill mission entitled "Memoirs of a Crimelord," which is available for players of both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and Republic factions. In a crew skill mission, the player sends one of their companions to complete the mission, but due to the mission being available to all classes, it is unknown who met with Zirchros. As a reward for the mission, the player receives some lost artifact fragments. The player can choose not to send their companion of the mission, so it is not guaranteed that anyone met with Zirchros.<ref name="Memoirs of a Crimelord" />
